approvedRows.question: Can worktree auto-isolation safely detect dirty overlap when planning path scopes use glob patterns?

approvedRows.rationale: Missing dirty overlap would risk writing in the main worktree when a worktree should be required.
approvedRows.userImpact: Future users get safer code-write automation because dirty worktree overlap is detected conservatively.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers get a small regression test and source-ownership fix before enabling automated writes.
